checks.detail: Clear deliverable (output.mp4 via scene.py), explicit constraints (algorithmic MoviePy, no hardcoded per-frame data), and unambiguous success criterion.
Line 7 explicitly states 'your sandbox times out in 2 hours'.
Conversational colleague-handoff tone, concise and direct.
No scoring, reward, verifier, or evaluation terms found in any agent-visible files.
Pre-installed tools listed, run command documented, and starter scene.py provides working skeleton.

info.task_summary: The agent must reverse-engineer a reference MP4 animation showing 4 shapes morphing (circle to square to diamond) and reproduce it algorithmically using MoviePy primitives in scene.py. The rendered output.mp4 must match the reference video.
